theater: 北不列顛（哈德良長城防線）

battle.name: 斯提利科的皮克特戰爭
battle.theater: 北不列顛（哈德良長城防線）
battle.brief: 398年，禁軍將軍斯提利科應皇帝霍諾留斯之命，率剛在北非平定基爾登叛亂的高盧老兵渡海入不列顛，擊潰越過哈德良長城劫掠的皮克特人，薩克森與海上來犯者亦一併潰散，繼以北非戰利款重修長城。史冊僅存詩人凱歌與修士怨言，卡面投石機為當時野戰序列的標準器械，負責拆毀木柵土壘。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 這場戰爭是西羅馬帝國與不列顛北部皮克特人之間的一場邊境戰役，交戰於西羅馬皇帝霍諾留斯在位初年，實際指揮者是禁軍將軍斯提利科。羅馬一方出動的是自高盧行省與意大利抽調的野戰軍主力，其中相當一部分是剛剛參與北非平定基爾登叛亂的高盧老兵，編制骨架仍是軍團、輔兵大隊與騎兵大隊，另有不列顛總督與各行省總督轄下的常備守軍，以及《軍政大全》所載部署在哈德良長城沿線的邊防單位：駐今南希爾茲的提格里西亞舟師營、駐里布徹斯特的薩爾馬提亞騎兵大隊等，並有不列顛艦隊負責運兵與護航。皮克特一方是北方部族聯盟，其領導層與決策方式在現存文獻中幾乎空白，只能確定其作戰以劫掠邊境聚落為主，並可聯合東岸、南岸活動的薩克森人與來自海上的「斯科特人」同時在多線牽制羅軍。羅馬方面的指揮極為集中：皇帝把北非與不列顛兩條戰線的處置權一併授予斯提利科，戰地決斷集於一身，遠勝於各自為戰的敵方聯盟。
countriesEn: This war was a frontier campaign fought in the opening years of the reign of the Western Roman emperor Honorius between the Roman Empire and the Picts of northern Britain, under the effective command of the magister militum Stilicho. The Roman side fielded the core of a field army drawn from the provinces of Gaul and Italy, a substantial part of it composed of Gallic veterans who had only just taken part in the suppression of Gildon's revolt in North Africa; its structure still rested on legions, auxiliary cohorts and cavalry alae, supplemented by the permanent garrison under the governor of Britain and the provincial governors, as well as by the frontier units listed in the Notitia Dignitatum along Hadrian's Wall: the numerus of the Tigrisian bargemen stationed at what is now South Shields, the cuneus of Sarmatian cavalry at Ribchester, and others, with the British fleet responsible for transport and escort. The Pictish side was a confederation of northern tribes whose leadership and decision-making are almost entirely blank in the surviving record; what can be fixed is that their operations took the form of raids on border settlements, and that they could act in concert with Saxons on the eastern and southern coasts and with the 'Scoti' coming over the sea, pinning the Roman forces on several fronts at once. Roman command was highly concentrated: the emperor placed the conduct of the African and the British theatres in the hands of Stilicho alone, so that battlefield decisions rested with one man, far more effective than the loose confederation opposite.
people: 斯提利科（Flavius Stilicho，約359至408年）是本役的關鍵人物。他出身半汪達爾家庭，卻在羅馬帝國晉身禁軍將軍，395年成為西羅馬皇帝霍諾留斯的岳父與首席大臣，實質上是西羅馬在萊茵、多瑙河與北非各戰線的總指揮。他於397至398年遠征北非，擊敗摩里亞總督基爾登的叛亂，翌年又應急折返不列顛平定北境與海岸的襲擊；401年他把駐不列顛的高盧軍團調回意大利，集結兵力對抗翻越阿爾卑斯山的汪達爾人與阿蘭人，402年在波倫蒂亞與維羅納連勝；但405年阿拉里克南下攻入希臘與意大利，他被皇帝召回解除兵權，408年被處決。皇帝霍諾留斯本人坐鎮米蘭，未曾親征。留下文字記錄的兩位是：為斯提利科唱頌歌的宮廷詩人克勞狄安，其《答歐特羅皮烏斯頌》是本役唯一的第一手文獻；以及六世紀的英格蘭修士基爾達斯，他在《不列顛的毀滅與征服》中稱本役為三次皮克特戰爭之一，同時痛責英格蘭人未能抵抗。近代愛德華·吉本在《羅馬帝國興亡史》中重述此事。
peopleEn: Stilicho (Flavius Stilicho, c. 359–408) is the decisive figure of this campaign. Born of a partly Vandal family, he rose in the Roman Empire to the rank of magister militum, and in 395 became the father-in-law and chief minister of the Western emperor Honorius, in effect the overall director of the Roman war effort on the Rhine, the Danube and in North Africa. He campaigned in North Africa in 397–398 and defeated the revolt of Gildon, the governor of Mauretania, then turned back to Britain in haste to settle the northern incursions and the raids on the coasts; in 401 he moved the Gallic legion stationed in Britain back to Italy in order to concentrate forces against the Vandals and Alans who had crossed the Alps, winning at Pollentia and Verona in 402; but in 405, when Alaric invaded Greece and Italy, he was recalled, stripped of his command, and executed in 408. The emperor Honorius himself remained at Milan and never campaigned in person. Two men left a written record: the court poet Claudianus, whose In Eutropium is the only first-hand source for the campaign, and Gildas, the sixth-century British monk, who in De Excidio et Conquestu Britanniae calls this one of the three Pictish wars while upbraiding the Britons for their failure to resist. In modern times Edward Gibbon retold the episode in The Decline and Fall of the Roman Empire.
kits: 卡面這件投石機（Onager）是四世紀末羅馬帝國野戰與攻城序列中的標準器械：木製機身、單一投臂、以配重絞盤儲存並釋放勢能，把石塊或鉛彈擲向城牆與土壘，使攻守雙方都能得到可以計算、可以重複的破壞力。當時羅馬野戰軍的投射兵器仍按《軍政大全》分列於各主力軍團與禁軍輔兵單位的裝備欄中，擲石器與弩砲同列，意味著它隨軍行進，而非只在城下器械庫待命。就398年的實際戰況而言，這場戰爭以追擊與掃清邊境游擊隊為主，雙方並無長期圍城，因此文獻無一提及本役曾實際發射擲石器；它更可能扮演威懾角色——羅軍把重裝備隊伍帶上不列顛，等於宣告邊境線仍有人守。本役真正可考的裝備有羅馬軍的短劍與長劍（spatha）、圓盾與大型盾牌、標槍（pilum）、輕投槍與弓箭，披掛鎖子甲，輔以高盧與不列顛的騎兵、隨軍車隊的運輸，以及往返布倫與不列顛海岸的運兵船。皮克特與薩克森一方的武器在文獻中完全沒有記載，只能確定其作戰依賴小船與步戰兵器，沒有留下任何攻城器械的痕跡。
kitsEn: The onager shown on the card was the standard engine of the late fourth-century Roman field and siege train: a timber frame with a single throwing arm, driven by a counterweighted winch that stored and released the power, hurling stones or lead shot at walls and ramparts so that both attack and defence could deal in a damage that could be calculated and repeated. At the time the missile equipment of the Roman field army still appears in the equipment columns of the Notitia Dignitatum for the various legions and for auxiliary units of the palace troops, with onagers listed alongside ballistae, which means the engine travelled with the army rather than waiting in a siege depot below a walled town. As far as the actual course of the year 398 is concerned, the war consisted of pursuit and of clearing the frontier of raiding bands, with no protracted siege on either side; the literature therefore never once mentions an onager being fired in this campaign. Its role was more probably one of intimidation: bringing a heavily equipped army to Britain announced that the frontier line was still manned. The equipment actually attested for the campaign includes the Roman shortsword and spatha, round and large oval shields, the pilum, light javelins and bows, mail armour, plus Gallic and British cavalry, wagon-borne transport, and the shipping that ferried men between Boulogne and the British coast. The weapons of the Picts and Saxons are wholly unrecorded; what can be fixed is that they fought with small boats and hand weapons, and left no trace of any siege engine.
tactics: 羅軍的戰法可以從殘存記載推知幾個層次。第一步是海運：斯提利科自布倫一帶的港口出發，渡過最窄處不過三十餘公里的英吉利海峽，以不列顛艦隊護送野戰軍登陸，戰馬與輜重隨船。登陸後，部隊沿德爾街等羅馬軍用道路北進，先解海岸城鎮之圍，再掃清哈德良長城以北的游擊地帶；目標是把越境劫掠的皮克特人逐回北方，而不是攻破某一座城——這是一場以速度與推進力取勝的邊境戰役。戰鬥過程被描述為一連串遭遇戰：皮克特人在開闊地帶列陣，羅軍以步兵方陣的持續推進與騎兵的縱深衝擊逐步壓垮其陣線，薩克森與海上的敵軍在同一時間被逐出，戰線因此得以分進合擊。得手之後，斯提利科沒有把遠征軍長期駐紮，而是抽走最關鍵的高盧軍團於401年調往意大利；同時以北非戰役的戰利款重修哈德良長城與沿線設防，把防禦重心重新壓回防線本身。這種以最小駐軍換取最長防線的部署，是四世紀末羅馬在不列顛防務上的實際形態：野戰軍可抽調、城防依賴石造工事與小型邊防單位，而代價則是不列顛在405至408年間完全失去了可用於機動作戰的中央兵力。
tacticsEn: Several layers of Roman method can be reconstructed from the fragmentary record. The first was a movement by sea: Stilicho sailed from the ports around Boulogne, crossed the narrowest stretch of the English Channel, a little over thirty kilometres at its tightest, and landed the field army under the escort of the British fleet, with horses and baggage shipped alongside. After landing, the columns advanced north along the Roman military roads such as Dere Street, first relieving the coastal towns, then clearing the zone of raiding north of Hadrian's Wall. The object was to drive the raiding Picts back beyond the line rather than to batter down any single city; this was a frontier war won by speed and momentum. The fighting is described as a series of encounters: the Picts formed up in the open, and the Romans broke their line by the sustained push of the infantry block and the deep charge of the cavalry, while the Saxons and the enemy from the sea were driven off at the same moment, so that the two fronts could be defeated in parallel. Having won, Stilicho did not leave the expeditionary army in the island for long; he withdrew the most valuable Gallic legion, which was moved to Italy in 401, and at the same time rebuilt Hadrian's Wall and its outposts with the money taken in the African campaign, pressing the weight of the defence back onto the line itself. This exchange of the smallest possible garrison for the longest possible wall was the actual shape of Roman defence in Britain at the end of the fourth century: a field army that could be pulled away, a frontier that relied on stone works and small frontier units, and the price was that between 405 and 408 Britain possessed no central force at all capable of manoeuvre.
data: 關於這場戰爭，可核實的數字極少，這本身就是最值得記錄的一項數據。羅馬方面沒有留下任何兵力表：遠征軍的具體人數、兵種配比與傷亡數字在當時文獻中全無記載，克勞狄安只以凱歌的語氣宣稱薩克森人潰散、皮克特人被打碎、不列顛重新安寧。比數字更可靠的是制度性資料：《軍政大全》記載不列顛常駐第二奧古斯都軍團、第六勝利者軍團、第二十瓦萊里亞勝利者軍團與第一密涅瓦軍團四支主力軍團，另有提格里西亞舟師營、里布徹斯特約五千五百人的薩爾馬提亞騎兵大隊等邊防單位，以及布倫與多佛兩端的艦隊基地；哈德良長城全長約一百二十公里，橫跨今英格蘭北部，正是本役羅軍必須恢復控制的那條線。地理上，布倫至多佛的海峽最窄處約三十餘公里，羅軍由海岸登陸至長城防線的推進距離為一百公里量級，相當於十日左右的強行軍行程。時間上，本役一般置於398年，戰後凱旋慶典在400年舉行，401年斯提利科開始籌備對付汪達爾人與阿蘭人的戰役，402年波倫蒂亞與維羅納兩役，405年阿拉里克攻入意大利，408年斯提利科被處決。此外，考古上至今沒有任何一處遺址被一致認定為本役的戰場。
dataEn: Very few verifiable figures survive for this war, and that absence is itself the most important datum to record. The Romans left no order of battle: the strength of the expeditionary army, the mix of its arms and its casualties are wholly unrecorded in the literature of the time, and Claudianus merely declares in the language of celebration that the Saxons were routed, the Picts broken, and Britain safe. More reliable than any numbers are the institutional data: the Notitia Dignitatum lists four legions permanently stationed in Britain — Legio II Augusta, Legio VI Victrix, Legio XX Valeria Victrix and Legio I Minervia — together with frontier units such as the Tigrisian bargemen and the Sarmatian cuneus of about five thousand five hundred men at Ribchester, plus the naval bases at Boulogne and Dover; Hadrian's Wall runs for about 120 kilometres across what is now northern England, and that is precisely the line the Roman army had to restore. Geographically, the narrowest point of the Channel between Boulogne and Dover is a little over thirty kilometres, and the distance from the landing coast to the frontier line is on the order of a hundred kilometres, roughly ten days of forced marching. As to time, the campaign is generally placed in 398; the triumph celebrating it was held in 400; in 401 Stilicho began preparing the war against the Vandals and Alans; 402 brought Pollentia and Verona; 405 saw Alaric in Italy; 408 saw Stilicho executed. In addition, no archaeological site has ever been agreed upon as the battlefield of this war.
cause: 要理解398年這一戰，得先看四世紀不列顛防務的結構。367至368年，羅馬將軍提奧多西在北方擊敗卡勒多尼與皮克特聯軍，完成一次越過福思河的遠征，把防線重新壓回哈德良長城；此後約三十年，不列顛享有相對安寧，靠的是兩件事：帝國仍能從高盧與意大利抽調野戰軍，以及長城沿線的邊防單位與本地徵召的後備兵力能及時填補缺口。這一平衡在四世紀末被打破。首先是野戰軍體系的萎縮：不列顛的軍團與輔兵大量被抽調去支援高盧、多瑙河與北非戰線，能在島上機動作戰的部隊越來越少。其次是北方的壓力：皮克特人越過長城劫掠邊境聚落，東岸與南岸又同時遭到薩克森人及「斯科特人」的海上襲擊，羅馬不可能同時在三個方向部署。第三是財政與運輸的負擔：為了支援北非戰線，不列顛被攤派大批糧食與物資，作物優先送往軍隊，島上因此出現饑荒，佐西莫斯記載運糧船隊被迫改道的事件；同時，作為西羅馬朝廷唯一能倚重的大臣，斯提利科要解決的不只是北非的叛亂，還有英吉利海峽另一端的邊境崩潰。他把北非的高盧老兵直接拉上船，帶著剛剛鍛鍊出來的實戰經驗北上，而不是從島上現有的守軍裡拼湊，這正是本役在戰術邏輯上的起點。
causeEn: To understand the campaign of 398 one must first grasp the structure of Britain's defence in the fourth century. In 367–368 the Roman general Theodosius defeated a coalition of Caledonians and Picts in the north in a campaign that carried him beyond the Forth and pressed the frontier back onto Hadrian's Wall. For roughly thirty years afterwards Britain enjoyed comparative quiet, and this rested on two things: the empire could still draw a field army out of Gaul and Italy, and the frontier units along the wall together with locally recruited reserves could plug gaps in time. That balance broke down at the end of the century. First, the field army system withered: legions and auxiliaries from Britain were repeatedly stripped to reinforce the Gallic, Danubian and African fronts, and the troops still able to manoeuvre on the island became ever fewer. Second, pressure from the north: the Picts crossed the wall to plunder border settlements, while the eastern and southern coasts were simultaneously raided by Saxons and by the 'Scoti' from the sea, and Rome could not concentrate on three fronts at once. Third came the burden of finance and transport: to support the North African war, Britain was assessed heavy contributions in grain and goods, with crops going to the army first and famine following on the island — Zosimus records a grain fleet driven off its course — and at the same time Stilicho, the one man the Western court could rely on, had to settle not only the revolt in Africa but the collapse of the frontier on the far side of the Channel. He put the Gallic veterans of North Africa directly aboard ship and carried north the hard-won experience of that campaign, rather than improvising an expedition out of the garrison already on the island, and that choice is where the tactical logic of the year 398 begins.
impact: 本役在羅馬史上留下的份量，幾乎全在「最後一次」這個形容詞上。它是西羅馬帝國在歐洲西部一次成功的邊境鎮壓，也是在不列顛境內最後一次大規模的羅馬野戰行動；此後羅馬的正規軍仍會在島上維持數十年，但再也沒有以征服者的姿態跨越福思河把皮克特人打回北方。直接結果是防線重建：斯提利科以北非戰役的戰利款修補哈德良長城及沿線工事，邊境重新成為可以依托的界線，北方游擊與沿海襲擊在短期內受到抑制。更深遠的影響來自斯提利科在401年做出的那個取捨：他把駐不列顛的高盧軍團抽回意大利，集中對付翻越阿爾卑斯山的汪達爾人與阿蘭人，402年波倫蒂亞與維羅納兩役因此得勝。代價卻留在不列顛島上：島內野戰兵力幾乎清空，只剩防線守備與地方徵召兵，405年阿拉里克南侵時無兵可調，407年不列顛守軍大批撤離，410年羅馬正式放棄不列顛，成為西方帝國崩解的標誌之一。另一層影響在記憶與史料：克勞狄安的凱歌讓本役成為「羅馬皇帝仍在西方有效」的樣板，六世紀的基爾達斯則把它當作英格蘭人失責的證據；從吉本到現代史家，398年這一役一直被用來標示羅馬在布列顛退場的起點。
impactEn: The weight this campaign carries in Roman history rests almost entirely on the phrase 'the last time'. It was a successful frontier suppression by the Western Roman Empire in the west of Europe, and the last large-scale Roman field operation inside Britain; the regular Roman army would remain on the island for decades afterwards, but it would never again cross the Forth and drive the Picts back to the north in the manner of a conqueror. The immediate result was the reconstruction of the frontier: Stilicho used the money of the African campaign to repair Hadrian's Wall and the works along it, the border again became a line that could be relied upon, and northern raiding and coastal incursions were checked in the short term. The more far-reaching effect sprang from the choice Stilicho made in 401: withdrawing the Gallic legion from Britain to Italy in order to concentrate against the Vandals and Alans south of the Alps, a concentration that won Pollentia and Verona in 402. The price, however, was left on the island: the field troops of Britain were very nearly emptied, leaving only the frontier garrison and locally recruited levies, so that when Alaric marched south in 405 there was nothing to move, the British garrison departed in large numbers in 407, and Rome formally relinquished Britain in 410 — one of the recognised markers of the collapse of the western empire. A further effect lies in memory and in the record: Claudianus' victory poem made the campaign a model of a Roman emperor still effective in the west, while the sixth-century Gildas used it as evidence of English failure; from Gibbon to modern historians, the war of 398 has continued to serve as the starting point for the Roman withdrawal from Britain.
result: 結局是羅馬方面的勝利。克勞狄安在頌詞中宣稱薩克森人潰散、海面平靜、皮克特人被打碎，不列顛重新安全；六世紀的基爾達斯雖痛責英格蘭人，卻也把這場戰爭列為三次皮克特戰爭之一，等於承認羅馬確實在北方取得了結果。皮克特人退回到長城以北，薩克森與海上的襲擊者在同一輪打擊中退出海岸，斯提利科得以以北非的戰利款重修哈德良長城與沿線工事，把邊境防務重新建立在石造防線與小型邊防單位之上。此役在軍事上結束了邊境游擊的威脅，在政治上則成為西羅馬最後一次成功的海外用兵。代價同樣清楚：為了在401年對付汪達爾人與阿蘭人，斯提利科抽走了駐不列顛的高盧軍團，島上不再有可用的野戰兵力；408年他本人被處決，405至410年間的連續崩潰隨之而來，羅馬治下的不列顛在十二年內走向終結。
resultEn: The outcome was a Roman victory. In the panegyric Claudianus announces that the Saxons were routed, the sea calmed, the Picts broken and Britain safe again; Gildas, though harsh in his criticism of the Britons, counts the war among the three Pictish wars, which amounts to an acknowledgement that Rome did in fact gain a result in the north. The Picts were driven back beyond Hadrian's Wall, the Saxons and the raiders from the sea withdrew from the coast in the same stroke, and Stilicho was able to rebuild Hadrian's Wall and its outposts with the money of the African campaign, setting the defence of the border once more on stone works and small frontier units. In military terms the campaign ended the threat of frontier raiding; in political terms it was the last successful overseas use of force by the Western Empire. The cost is equally plain: to face the Vandals and Alans in 401, Stilicho took away the Gallic legion stationed in Britain, and the island was left with no field army at all; he himself was executed in 408, the collapse of 405 to 410 followed, and Roman Britain came to an end within a dozen years.
